question.text:
$ ewcommand{\arsinh}{\mathop{ m arsinh} olimits} ewcommand{\arcosh}{\mathop{ m arcosh} olimits} ewcommand{\artanh}{\mathop{ m artanh} olimits} ewcommand{\sech}{\mathop{ m sech} olimits} ewcommand{\csch}{\mathop{ m csch} olimits} ewcommand{\coth}{\mathop{ m coth} olimits} ewcommand{\arsech}{\mathop{ m arsech} olimits} ewcommand{\arcsch}{\mathop{ m arcsch} olimits} ewcommand{\arcoth}{\mathop{ m arcoth} olimits} $

$\displaystyle \int \dfrac{5}{2|x|\sqrt{x^2+1}}\, extrm d x=$
question.explanation:
$ \newcommand{\arsinh}{\mathop{\rm arsinh}\nolimits} \newcommand{\arcosh}{\mathop{\rm arcosh}\nolimits} \newcommand{\artanh}{\mathop{\rm artanh}\nolimits} \newcommand{\sech}{\mathop{\rm sech}\nolimits} \newcommand{\csch}{\mathop{\rm csch}\nolimits} \newcommand{\coth}{\mathop{\rm coth}\nolimits} \newcommand{\arsech}{\mathop{\rm arsech}\nolimits} \newcommand{\arcsch}{\mathop{\rm arcsch}\nolimits} \newcommand{\arcoth}{\mathop{\rm arcoth}\nolimits} $

The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic cosecant function is \[ \dfrac{\textrm{d}}{\textrm{d}x}(\arcsch x) = -\dfrac{1}{|x|\sqrt{1+ x^2}}. \]

Therefore, we have

\begin{align*} \int \dfrac{5}{2|x|\sqrt{x^2+1}} \,\textrm d x =-\dfrac{5}{2}\int -\dfrac{1}{|x|\sqrt{1 + x^2}} \,\textrm d x =-\dfrac{5}{2}\arcsch{x}+C. \end{align*}

question.text: $ ewcommand{\arsinh}{\mathop{ m arsinh} olimits} ewcommand{\arcosh}{\mathop{ m arcosh} olimits} ewcommand{\artanh}{\mathop{ m artanh} olimits} ewcommand{\sech}{\mathop{ m sech} olimits} ewcommand{\csch}{\mathop{ m csch} olimits} ewcommand{\coth}{\mathop{ m coth} olimits} ewcommand{\arsech}{\mathop{ m arsech} olimits} ewcommand{\arcsch}{\mathop{ m arcsch} olimits} ewcommand{\arcoth}{\mathop{ m arcoth} olimits} \displaystyle \int \dfrac{x+1}{x\sqrt{1-x^2}} extrm d x=$
question.explanation:
$ \newcommand{\arsinh}{\mathop{\rm arsinh}\nolimits} \newcommand{\arcosh}{\mathop{\rm arcosh}\nolimits} \newcommand{\artanh}{\mathop{\rm artanh}\nolimits} \newcommand{\sech}{\mathop{\rm sech}\nolimits} \newcommand{\csch}{\mathop{\rm csch}\nolimits} \newcommand{\coth}{\mathop{\rm coth}\nolimits} \newcommand{\arsech}{\mathop{\rm arsech}\nolimits} \newcommand{\arcsch}{\mathop{\rm arcsch}\nolimits} \newcommand{\arcoth}{\mathop{\rm arcoth}\nolimits} $

The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic secant function is \[ \dfrac{\textrm{d}}{\textrm{d}x}(\arsech x) = -\dfrac{1}{x\sqrt{1-x^2}}. \]

Therefore, we have \begin{align*} \int \dfrac{x+1}{x\sqrt{1-x^2}} \textrm d x & = \int \left(1+\dfrac{1}{x}\right)\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{1-x^2}} \, \textrm d x \\[5pt] & = \int\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{1-x^2}} \, \textrm d x - \int - \dfrac{1}{x\sqrt{1-x^2}} \, \textrm d x\\[5pt] & = \arcsin x - \arsech{x} + C. \end{align*}

question.text:
$ ewcommand{\arsinh}{\mathop{ m arsinh} olimits} ewcommand{\arcosh}{\mathop{ m arcosh} olimits} ewcommand{\artanh}{\mathop{ m artanh} olimits} ewcommand{\sech}{\mathop{ m sech} olimits} ewcommand{\csch}{\mathop{ m csch} olimits} ewcommand{\coth}{\mathop{ m coth} olimits} ewcommand{\arsech}{\mathop{ m arsech} olimits} ewcommand{\arcsch}{\mathop{ m arcsch} olimits} ewcommand{\arcoth}{\mathop{ m arcoth} olimits} $

Calculate $\displaystyle \int \dfrac{2x^3 - 2x - 1}{x^2 - 1}\, extrm d x $ for $|x|>1.$
question.explanation:
$ \newcommand{\arsinh}{\mathop{\rm arsinh}\nolimits} \newcommand{\arcosh}{\mathop{\rm arcosh}\nolimits} \newcommand{\artanh}{\mathop{\rm artanh}\nolimits} \newcommand{\sech}{\mathop{\rm sech}\nolimits} \newcommand{\csch}{\mathop{\rm csch}\nolimits} \newcommand{\coth}{\mathop{\rm coth}\nolimits} \newcommand{\arsech}{\mathop{\rm arsech}\nolimits} \newcommand{\arcsch}{\mathop{\rm arcsch}\nolimits} \newcommand{\arcoth}{\mathop{\rm arcoth}\nolimits} $ The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic cotangent function is \[ \dfrac{\textrm{d}}{\textrm{d}x}(\arcoth x) = \dfrac{1}{1-x^2}. \]

Therefore, we have \begin{align*} \int \dfrac{2x^3 - 2x - 1}{x^2 - 1} \, \textrm d x & = \int \left(\dfrac{2x^3 - 2x}{x^2 - 1} - \dfrac{1}{x^2 - 1}\right) \textrm{d}x\\[5pt] & = \int \dfrac{2x^3 - 2x}{x^2 - 1} \, \textrm{d}x - \int \dfrac{1}{x^2 - 1} \, \textrm{d}x\\[5pt] & = \int \dfrac{2x(x^2 - 1)}{x^2 - 1} \, \textrm{d}x - \int \dfrac{1}{x^2 - 1} \, \textrm{d}x\\[5pt] & = \int 2x \, \textrm{d}x + \int \dfrac{1}{1 - x^2} \, \textrm{d}x\\[5pt] & = x^2 + \arcoth{x} + C. \end{align*}

question.text: $ ewcommand{\arsinh}{\mathop{ m arsinh} olimits} ewcommand{\arcosh}{\mathop{ m arcosh} olimits} ewcommand{\artanh}{\mathop{ m artanh} olimits} ewcommand{\sech}{\mathop{ m sech} olimits} ewcommand{\csch}{\mathop{ m csch} olimits} ewcommand{\coth}{\mathop{ m coth} olimits} ewcommand{\arsech}{\mathop{ m arsech} olimits} ewcommand{\arcsch}{\mathop{ m arcsch} olimits} ewcommand{\arcoth}{\mathop{ m arcoth} olimits} \displaystyle \int -\dfrac{1}{\sqrt2x\sqrt{2-2x^2}}\, extrm d x=$
question.explanation:
$ \newcommand{\arsinh}{\mathop{\rm arsinh}\nolimits} \newcommand{\arcosh}{\mathop{\rm arcosh}\nolimits} \newcommand{\artanh}{\mathop{\rm artanh}\nolimits} \newcommand{\sech}{\mathop{\rm sech}\nolimits} \newcommand{\csch}{\mathop{\rm csch}\nolimits} \newcommand{\coth}{\mathop{\rm coth}\nolimits} \newcommand{\arsech}{\mathop{\rm arsech}\nolimits} \newcommand{\arcsch}{\mathop{\rm arcsch}\nolimits} \newcommand{\arcoth}{\mathop{\rm arcoth}\nolimits} $

The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic secant function is \[ \dfrac{\textrm{d}}{\textrm{d}x}(\arsech x) = -\dfrac{1}{x\sqrt{1-x^2}}. \]

Therefore, we have

\begin{align*} \int -\dfrac{1}{\sqrt2x\sqrt{2-2x^2}}\,\textrm d x &=\int -\dfrac{1}{\sqrt2x\sqrt{2\left(1-x^2\right)}}\,\textrm d x \\[5pt] &=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt2\cdot\sqrt2}\int -\dfrac{1}{x\sqrt{1-x^2}}\,\textrm d x \\[5pt] &=\dfrac12\arsech x +C. \end{align*}

question.text:
$ ewcommand{\arsinh}{\mathop{ m arsinh} olimits} ewcommand{\arcosh}{\mathop{ m arcosh} olimits} ewcommand{\artanh}{\mathop{ m artanh} olimits} ewcommand{\sech}{\mathop{ m sech} olimits} ewcommand{\csch}{\mathop{ m csch} olimits} ewcommand{\coth}{\mathop{ m coth} olimits} ewcommand{\arsech}{\mathop{ m arsech} olimits} ewcommand{\arcsch}{\mathop{ m arcsch} olimits} ewcommand{\arcoth}{\mathop{ m arcoth} olimits} $

Calculate $\displaystyle \int- \dfrac{5}{\sqrt{5}(1-x^2)}\, extrm d x$ for $|x|>1.$
question.explanation:
$ \newcommand{\arsinh}{\mathop{\rm arsinh}\nolimits} \newcommand{\arcosh}{\mathop{\rm arcosh}\nolimits} \newcommand{\artanh}{\mathop{\rm artanh}\nolimits} \newcommand{\sech}{\mathop{\rm sech}\nolimits} \newcommand{\csch}{\mathop{\rm csch}\nolimits} \newcommand{\coth}{\mathop{\rm coth}\nolimits} \newcommand{\arsech}{\mathop{\rm arsech}\nolimits} \newcommand{\arcsch}{\mathop{\rm arcsch}\nolimits} \newcommand{\arcoth}{\mathop{\rm arcoth}\nolimits} $ The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic cotangent function is \[ \dfrac{\textrm{d}}{\textrm{d}x}(\arcoth x) = \dfrac{1}{1-x^2}. \]

Therefore, we have

\begin{align*} \int - \dfrac{5}{\sqrt{5}(1-x^2)} \,\textrm d x =-\dfrac{5}{\sqrt{5}}\int \dfrac{1}{1-x^2} \,\textrm d x =-{\sqrt{5}}\arcoth{x}+C. \end{align*}
